title: Base -2 Representation
description: Given a non-negative integer `n`, return a binary string consisting of `'0'` and `'1'` representing `n` in base `-2` (negabinary), where bit position `k` carries weight `(-2)^k`. The returned string must not have leading zeros unless `n == 0` (which returns `"0"`).
hints: At each step, the least significant negabinary digit is `n & 1` (either 0 or 1).
Subtracting that digit and dividing by `-2` is equivalent to `n = -(n >> 1)` using arithmetic right shift.
